APPROVE
`ExpressAndFastify` now holds only the loop and one `if` (well under 15), the extracted `JudgeCall` and `RouteTarget` keep every early-exit, chain-versus-plain branch and guard expression in the same order with the same types, and the nullable-tuple `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` pattern compiles and leaves the locals definitely assigned after the check.
